svg.title: One list of events, read from many positions
svg.desc: Left: a thread stored as a list of six events in order, each with a fixed address; an edited comment is appended as a new record under its old address. Right: readers keep a position in that log. A first context covers the four events that exist and ends with a cursor. A later read with --since returns only the edit and the check that came after. Two tickets on the same thread keep their own positions: one has nothing unread, the other four events. Measured: over the life of an issue, a first context and updates took a median of 2,897 tokens against 21,103 for rereading, on 151 issues; with 24 tickets following 71 threads of astral-sh/ruff, fetching everything took 278 requests and a poll with nothing new took 13.
svg.text: One list of events, read from many
WHAT IS STORED: THE EVENTS, IN ORDER
Records are only added. An edit is one more record.
A reader keeps a position in the log. Nothing is copied.
only the edit and the check
Each square is one event of the log. Blue is what the reader receives.
Measured. 151 issues, a median of 6 returns each: 2,897 tokens for a first
context and updates, against 21,103 for reading the thread again each time.
24 tickets following 71 threads of astral-sh/ruff: 278 requests to fetch
everything, 13 for a poll with nothing new.
